Christian Dobmeier
[[Christian Dobmeier]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Director of Product Group CMX500；目前本頁只由 [[Gatehouse Satcom and Rohde & Schwarz formalize collaboration to strengthen 5G GEO- and LEO-NTN validation and testing]] 支撐。

Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices › 重點摘要
- [[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 擴展既有合作，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software。
- 整合後，next-generation WLAN technology 的 developers 與 manufacturers 可使用 [[Bluetest]] reverberation test systems（RTS）對 [[IEEE 802.11be]] stations 與 access points 在 realistic conditions 下進行 MIMO stress testing。
- 來源以 [[Bluetest RTS65]] 為例，說明 [[Bluetest]] reverberation chambers 用於 wireless devices 的 over-the-air performance evaluation。
- 來源說明 reverberation chamber 與 anechoic test chamber 的差異：reverberation chamber 會在 chamber 內大量反射 RF signal，形成 Rayleigh faded multipath RF environment；此環境接近 real-world indoor and city conditions。
- [[Bluetest Flow]] 被描述為 complex wireless solutions 的 integrated test environment。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 被描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester，具 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality、multiple radio technologies support 與 embedded IP test capabilities。
- [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 的 key components 被列為 320 MHz channel bandwidth、up to 16 spatial streams、4096 QAM modulation 與 [[MLO]]。
- 來源指出 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature；因此測試環境提供 multiple RF chains 很關鍵。
- Rohde & Schwarz 引言人物為 [[Christoph Pointner]]，職稱 Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers at Rohde & Schwarz。
- Bluetest 引言人物為 [[Kjell Olovsson]]，職稱 Bluetest CEO。
- Press & media contact 為 [[Christian Mokry]]，PR Manager Test & measurement，email 為 press@rohde-schwarz.com。
- Rohde & Schwarz 公司資訊：2024/2025 fiscal year（July to June）net revenue EUR 3.16 billion；2025-06-30 員工超過 15,000 人。
- Bluetest 公司資訊：[[Bluetest AB]] based in Gothenburg, Sweden；來源稱其為 wireless equipment and small antenna OTA testing using Reverberation Test System 的 pioneer and market leader。

answer.text:
| Chain step | Supported mapping | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense market requirement | Deployed 5G private networks need resilience in Smart Jamming / EW environments; the source also asks whether frequency hopping can improve 5G resilience without modifying the DUT. | [13] |
| Measurable parameter / test focus | In O-RU testing, key test focus areas include timing / sync / signal integrity and network synchronization. | [16] |
| Oscilloscope capability required | The oscilloscope must support timing / synchronization / signal-integrity measurement use cases in an O-RU or 5G infrastructure test setup; R&S RTO / RTP are listed as general instrumentation for O-RU testing. | [16] |
【推論】For an Aerospace / Defense 5G private-network resilience use case, the oscilloscope-relevant requirement can be mapped as: resilience under Smart Jamming / EW → verify timing / sync / signal integrity → use an oscilloscope class represented in the knowledge base by R&S RTO / RTP for O-RU testing instrumentation. [13][16]
